query_data_OssDataFetcher: query data from a Spark table and perform RL preprocessing including reward calculation and sparse to dense conversion
calc_custom_reward: calculate a custom reward column in a Spark DataFrame using a SQL expression and replace the existing reward
calc_reward_multi_steps: compute multi-step discounted rewards from an array of reward values using a gamma discount factor
hash_mdp_id_and_subsample: hash MDP IDs with CRC32 and optionally subsample rows based on a percentage range
make_sparse2dense: convert a sparse map column in a Spark DataFrame to a dense float array with a presence mask
